question: Every day, Janet's ducks produce 16 eggs. Each morning, she consumes three for her breakfast and uses four to bake muffins for her friends. She sells the leftover eggs at the local farmers' market, where each fresh duck egg goes for $2. How much money does she earn daily from selling eggs at the farmers' market?

Carlos is planting a lemon tree. The tree will cost $90 to plant. Each year it will grow 7 lemons, which he can sell for some money each. It costs $3 a year to water and feed the tree. It would take 13 years before he starts earning money on the lemon tree. How much can he sell each lemon for?

Two trains leave San Rafael at the same time. They begin traveling westward, both traveling for 60 miles. The next day, they travel northwards, covering 120 miles. What's the distance covered by each train in the two days?
John is responsible for 10 canines. He spends half an hour each day on walking and attending to each dog's needs. What is the total number of hours he dedicates to these tasks in a week?
Siobhan has 2 fewer jewels than Aaron. Aaron has 5 more jewels than half of Raymond's jewels. If Siobhan has 23 jewels, how many jewels does Raymond have?

John plans to sell all his toys and use the money to buy video games. He has 13 lego sets and he sells them for $16.5 each. He ends up buying 8 video games for $20 each and has $21.5 left. How many lego sets does he still have?
Tracy used a piece of wire 4 feet long to support tomato plants in the garden. The wire was cut into pieces certain inches long. At last she obtains 8 pieces, then how many inches was each piece?

Uriah finds his backpack overly burdensome. He has to lighten it by 15 pounds. Each of his comic books has a weight of 1/4 pound, and each of his toys has a weight of 1/2 pound. If he decides to take out 30 comic books, how many of his toys must he also remove?

A mechanic charges different rates to repair the tires of trucks and cars.  For each truck tire that is repaired, the mechanic will charge $60 and for each car tire that is repaired, the mechanic will charge $40. It takes 30 minutes to repair a car tire every time. On Thursday, the mechanic repairs 6 truck tires and 4 car tires.  On Friday, the mechanic repairs 12 car tires and doesn't repair any truck tires.  How much more revenue did the mechanic earn on the day with higher revenue?

If Marcy works for the same company for 35 years, she gets an annual pension of $60,000/year. Starting after 25 years, she becomes entitled to 3% of the value of the pension per year. If she quits after 40 years, what will her annual pension be?

Aleena subscribed to a streaming service that charges her $140 per month. In the first half of the year, she was also participating in a fitness program that cost her $200 per month, but she dropped it in the second half of the year. If the streaming company charged her the initial amount for the first half of the year and then charged her 10% less money on the other half of the year, while the fitness program costs had no impact on her streaming service payments, calculate the total amount she had paid for the streaming service by the end of the year.
Jim spends 2.6 hours watching TV and then decides to go to bed and reads for half as long.  He does this 3 times a week.  How many hours does he spend on TV and reading in 4 weeks?

A treasure hunter found a buried treasure chest filled with gems. There were 1200 diamonds, 200 fewer rubies than diamonds, and twice the number of emeralds than the rubies.   How many of the gems were there in the chest?

Artie has a flower stand at the Farmers Market. He sells three kinds of flowers: marigolds, petunias and begonias. He usually sells marigolds for $3.74 per pot, petunias for $2.87 per pot and begonias for $3.12 per pot. Artie has no change today, so he has decided to round all his prices to the nearest dollar. If Artie sells 15 pots of marigolds, 8 pots of petunias and 18 pots of begonias, how much will he make?

Luke is spending time at the beach building sandcastles while his friend, Mark, is flying a kite nearby. Mark's kite is 50 feet high in the sky, but this doesn't affect Luke's sandcastle building. Luke notices that each level of a sandcastle will have half the square footage as the level below it. If he makes a 4 leveled sandcastle where the top level has a square footage of 16, despite the wind speed being 10 mph, what is the average square footage of a level?
Grace weighs 125.5 pounds. Alex weighs 2.5 pounds less than 4 times what Grace weighs. What are their combined weights in pounds?

Greg has an alarm set to ring three times a day as a reminder. When the alarm goes off, it continues to ring until Greg turns it off. There is a 5-minute interval between each ring. The first time it went off today, it rang four times. The second time it went off, it rang for three times as long as the first time. The third time, it rang for half as long as the second time. How many times did the alarm ring in all?

A company pays each of its employees $650.5 a month. The company has a policy of increasing the salaries of each of its employees by 0.15 of the initial salary every year for those who've stayed in the company for five years. If Sylvie just clocked 5 years in the company last December, what's her annual salary after three more years of service?

When Freda cooks canned tomatoes into sauce, they lose half their volume. Each 16.25 ounce can of tomatoes that she uses contains three tomatoes. Freda’s last batch of tomato sauce made 32.5 ounces of sauce. How many tomatoes did Freda use?

Mary is an avid gardener. Yesterday, she received 1.8 times of ten new potted plants from her favorite plant nursery. She already has 2 potted plants on each of the 2/5 of one hundred window ledges of her large country home. Feeling generous, she has decided that she will give 1 potted plant from each ledge to friends and family tomorrow. How many potted plants will Mary remain with?

Frankie watches TV after he finishes his homework every night. On Monday and Tuesday, he watched a 100-minute episode of his favorite show each night. On Wednesday, he watched a few episodes of a 50-minute show. On Thursday, he finished homework early and watched a 100-minute episode and a 50-minute show. On Friday, he got to stay up late for the weekend, so he watched two 100-minute episodes. If he watched 700 minutes of TV in all, how many 50-minute episodes did he watch on Wednesday?

A classroom has a whiteboard which is shared between the 4 teachers who take turns using the classroom. Each teacher has 2 lessons per day and uses the whiteboard in each lesson. If the whiteboard is cleaned 10 times per lesson, how many times is the whiteboard cleaned in a day?
The expenditure of Joseph in May was $5000. In June, his expenditure was $600 less. How much was his total expenditure for those two months?
On Monday, Walt walked 10 miles. Tuesday, he walked 6 times as many miles as he walked on Monday. His total mileage Monday through Wednesday was 140 miles. How many miles did he walk on Wednesday?

John has 10 hectares of a pineapple field, and each hectare can produce 100 pineapples. He also has a mango field of 5 hectares, but the mangoes are not ready for harvest yet. John can harvest his pineapples every 3 months, while the mangoes take 6 months to mature. Ignoring the mango field, how many pineapples can John harvest from his pineapple field within a year?

Dave bought a large pack of french fries and ate fourteen before a hungry seagull stole the pack out of his hand. When the seagull landed, he gobbled down half the amount of french fries that Dave ate. Then ten pigeons bullied him away from the food, and each pigeon ate three fries. Later, a raccoon stole two thirds of the remaining fries. Ants carried off a final french fry, leaving fifteen behind. How many french fries were in the pack when Dave bought it?

A bag of marbles costs $20, with the price increasing by 20 percent every two months. However, after 36 months, due to the annual sale, the store decided to discount 10%, so after 36 months, how much does a bag of marbles cost?

Sandra's neighbor gives her a basket of 9 eggs every time she babysits their daughter. To make a Spanish flan, she needs 3 eggs. If Sandra has been tasked to make 15 Spanish flans for her school fundraiser, additionally, Sandra's brother has asked her to make 3 more Spanish flans for his birthday party, how many times does Sandra have to babysit?

Juan and his brother Carlos are selling lemonade. For each gallon they make it costs $3 for lemons and $2 for sugar. They sell each glass for $0.50 and get 20 glasses per gallon. If they made $25 in profit, which spent 4 hours, how much did they spend on lemons?

A trader buys some bags of wheat from a farmer at a rate of $40 per bag. If it costs $4 to transport each bag from the farm to the warehouse, and the trader made a total profit of $800 after selling all the bags at a rate of $60 each, how many bags did he sell?

Tom plants 10 trees a year.  Every year he also chops down 2 trees a year.  He starts with some trees.  After 10 years 30% of the trees die, he have left 91 tress. How many trees does Tom start with ?

Violetta wants to buy new crayons. She needs them in 5 different colors and prepared $20 for this purchase. One crayon costs $2. However, she also wants to buy a coloring book that costs $5. After buying the crayons and the coloring book, how much change will she get?

Mark is a copy-editor. He edits an equal number of sentences each week for two different publishers, who each pay him a different rate per sentence. Publisher B pays Mark twice what Publisher A pays. Mark edits a total number of 100,000 sentences each week, and Publisher A pays him 50 cents per sentence. How much does Mark make in a week, in cents?

In the mathematics class taught by Mr. Bert, Brinley is one of the students. Each semester, Mr. Bert administers six examinations and permits the students to exclude their lowest score from the semester's average. Brinley has received scores of 89, 71, 92, 100, and 86 on her initial five exams. What must be her score on the final exam to achieve a semester average of 93?

Rose went to the store on Monday and bought 4 cakes. Tuesday she went to a different store and bought 3.5 times that number of cakes. On Wednesday she went to another store and bought 5.5 times the number of cakes she did on Tuesday. How many cakes did she buy after all three days?

Sara wants to buy herself a new jacket and 2 pairs of shoes. The jacket she wants costs $30 and each pair of shoes cost $20.5. Sara babysits the neighbor's kids 4 times, earning $5.5 each time she babysits them. Her parents pay her $3.9 each time she mows the lawn. If Sara already had $10 saved before she started babysitting, how many times must she mow the lawn before she can afford the jacket and shoes?

Gary likes to walk around the edge of the local park, which is a rectangle that measures 1.5 miles by 6 miles. If he spends 5 hours walking at a constant speed, how fast is he walking in miles per hour?

While at the dollar store, Sloane counts 200 customers entering the store. The next day, she counts 80 more customers than the first day. If the total number of customers by the third day was 800, how many customers did she count on the third day?
Adrian's age is three times the age of Harriet, and Harriet is half the age of Zack. Calculate the average age of the three in three years if Harriet is 2.1 times of ten years old now.

It takes Carmen 10 minutes to finish a crossword puzzle and 5 minutes to finish a sudoku puzzle.  Over the weekend she solved 3 crossword puzzles and 8 sudoku puzzles. She also took a 15-minute break to enjoy her coffee, but this didn't interrupt her puzzle-solving time. How much time did she spend solving these puzzles over the weekend?

Carlos and Benji are at the beach on a sunny day. Carlos decides to rent a canoe for $30 an hour and also buys a beach umbrella for $15, which he uses throughout the day. Benji, on the other hand, rents a banana boat raft for $18 an hour and also purchases a beach ball for $10, which he uses to play with during his breaks. If Carlos uses the canoe for 3 hours and Benji uses the raft for 5 hours, ignoring the cost of the beach umbrella and the beach ball, how much will they pay for their rentals, altogether?

Andrew is planning a road trip from New Jersey to Rochester. He has calculated that it will take him 6 days to travel by bus. He also found out that if he travels by car, he can make the journey in half the time it takes by bus. However, he also noticed that if he travels by bike, it would take him 18 days, and if he travels by foot, it would take him 60 days. But Andrew has decided to go to Rochester by bus and return from Rochester by car. How many days will his round trip take?

For his midday meal, Chad decided to customize his own burrito. The basic burrito costs $6.50. He opted for additional meat at $2.00, more cheese at $1.00, avocado at $1.00, and two types of sauces at $0.25 each. He also chose to enhance his meal with chips and a drink for an additional $3.00. At the time of payment, he utilized a $5.00 gift card. What is the remaining amount he needs to pay?

Kalinda is working on a 540 piece puzzle with her mom. Kalinda can normally add 6 pieces per minute. Her mom can typically place half as many pieces per minute as Kalinda.  How many hours will it take them to complete this puzzle?

A watermelon farm produced 120 baby watermelons. Ashlyn went to the farm after two months and found out that 0.3 times of the watermelons were ready for harvest, so she took them home. When she came back two weeks later, 0.75 times of the remaining melons were ready, so she harvested them. How many melons were not ready to be harvested after the two weeks?

Steve decides to start eating more tomatoes and decides to grow his cherry tomatoes. He eats 1.5 times as much as his girlfriend. He eats 0.5 dozen per day. If a vine can produce 1/3 dozen tomatoes per week, how many vines does he need at least?
Jessa is 20 years old, and Joan is five years her senior. Mary, on the other hand, is two years junior to Joan. Can you calculate the total age of Jessa, Joan, and Mary?

The number of students in a school hall was 1000. The hall had 3 entrances A, B, and C which also served as the exits. If after a meeting some of the students went out of the building through exit A, 3/5 of the remaining went out through exit B, and the rest went out through exit C, if the number of students who went out through exit C is 280, calculate the percentage of students who went out through exit A.

In a marine biology lab, there are two aquariums. One aquarium houses 4 snails and 5 starfish, while the other aquarium contains 32 snails and 7 sea urchins. The difference between the number of snails in the two aquariums is twice the total number of fish in both aquariums. If both aquariums have the same number of fish in them, how many fish are there in each aquarium?
A juggler can juggle 4/25 of one hundred balls.  Half of the balls are golf balls, and half of the golf balls are blue.  How many blue golf balls are there?

Carly had 8000 cards, 2/5 of the cards had the letter A on them, 1/2 of the remaining had the letter B, 5/8 of the rest had the letter C on them, and the others had the letter D. How many of the cards had the letter D on them?

Ruby is 6 times older than Sam. In a parallel universe where time flows at the same rate, Ruby's alien doppelganger is also 6 times older than Sam's. In 9 years, despite any intergalactic events that may occur, Ruby will be 3 times as old as Sam. If the alien doppelganger's age follows the same pattern, how old is Sam now in our universe?
Kelly has 5 quarters and 2 dimes. If she buys a can of pop for 55 cents and a candy bar for 45 cents, how many cents will she have left?

4 adults and 8 children are to share 8 packets of chocolate bars. Each packet contains 5 chocolate bars. If each adult gets 6 chocolate bars and the rest are to be shared equally among the children, then, each adult takes out two chocolate bars and divides them equally among the children, how many will each child get?

Darren decides to do body exercises for a whole week. He does 100 pushups, 50 squats, and 20 dumbbell presses on the first day, which takes 3 hours. On the second day, he does 20 more pushups than on the first day, ten fewer squats, and doubles the number of dumbbell presses. What's the total count of the activities he's done in the two days?

Peter has a goal to work out on Tuesday for a duration that is double the total time he spent exercising on both Sunday and Monday. If he exercised for 23 minutes on Sunday and 16 minutes on Monday, what is the total time in minutes that Peter needs to exercise on Tuesday to achieve his goal?

Elise has been selling her Dad's collection of 250 books for three years. Each book sells at 20.5$, and she sold twice as many books in the first year as she has sold in the current year. There are currently 50 unsold books, and her sales number this year is 45. What's the total amount of money she earned in the second year?

Watson works a 12-hour shift each day, five days a week. He earns $12 per hour and gets a $500 bonus each week if the company performs well. How much money did Watson make in April if the company performed very well for the whole month?

Sandy wants to lose as much weight as Joey does but needs 4 weeks to lose the same amount of weight that Joey loses in a single week. If Joey loses 12 pounds in 4 weeks, how many weeks will it take Sandy to lose the same amount of weight?

In a family, three people eat three eggs each day while the rest eat two eggs each day. If they eat eggs every day, and 91 eggs will be consumed by the family consume in a week. How many people are there in the family?
A magazine costs half as much as a book. The book costs $4. A pen costs $1 less than a magazine. An eraser costs $1.50 less than a magazine. How much is the pen?

Shannon prepares her iced coffee by first brewing hot coffee and then introducing ice cubes. Each ice cube reduces the coffee's temperature by 13 degrees and dilutes the coffee by 12 milliliters. The coffee's strength is also affected by any additional liquid. If Shannon's iced coffee is chilled by 65 degrees and she incorporates 15 milliliters of cream, by how many milliliters has the coffee been diluted?

Mason needs 30 ounces of sugar to make a batch of suckers and 70 ounces of sugar to make a batch of fudge. He also needs an additional 10 ounces of sugar for each batch of suckers to sprinkle on top and 20 ounces of sugar for the fudge to make a sugar glaze. How much sugar does he need in total to make 8 batches of suckers (including the extra sugar for sprinkling) and 1 batch of fudge (including the extra sugar for the glaze)?
Luke ate 4 hot dogs. Thomas ate three times more hot dogs than Luke. John ate half the amount Thomas ate. How many more hot dogs did John eat than Luke?
At a restaurant, Juice Box A is 4.5 dollars. Juice Box B is 5.5 dollars more than Juice Box A. Juice Box C is 7.5 dollars more than Juice Box A. How much more is Juice box C than Juice Box B?

Peyton scheduled after-work activities of a one-hour yoga class on Monday, a cooking class that lasts three times as long as Monday’s yoga on Tuesday, a half-hour cheese-tasting event on Wednesday, a museum tour that takes half as long as the cooking class on Thursday, and some hours of errands on Friday. If all of Peyton's after-work activities took 8 hours, how long did he spend running errands on Friday?

Billy is buying some candy with $30 his father gave him. The candy costs $1.2 a pound. After buying candy, he takes half his change and spends it on gumballs, which cost $0.15 each. If he bought 60 gumballs, how many pounds of candy did he buy?

Ethan made his own hand-painted wallpaper and it cost him $320 after considering the materials cost. If a DIY saves him 20% compared to the market price, how much does a hand-painted wallpaper cost at the market?

A company bought $400000 worth of equipment from a retailer business, but pieces of equipment worth 40% of the total number were faulty. The company used the equipment to make a profit of $100,000. If they returned the faulty pieces of equipment to the seller, calculate the total amount of money spent on functioning pieces of equipment.

There are 40 pupils in a class. Half of the class likes blue. One-fourth of the remaining class likes green and the rest likes yellow. If 5 students who like yellow switch their preference to green, how many pupils like the color yellow?

Axel has half of one hundred silver pesos and 4/5 of one hundred gold pesos. He visits her friend Anna who has twice as many silver pesos as he has and 40 more gold pesos. What's the total number of pesos they have together?

Monica is wrapping Christmas gifts. She has 8 gifts to wrap for her family, 5 gifts to wrap for her friends and 3 gifts to wrap for her teachers. She has 256 inches of ribbon and wants to make a bow for each gift with it.How many inches of ribbon can she use for each gift bow?

Tim decides to cancel his cable subscription and get streaming services.  He gets Netflix for $10.5 a month.  Hulu and Disney Plus normally cost $10.5 a month each but he saves 20% for bundling.  How much money does he save by cancelling his $60.5 cable package?
Mark has been saving $10 per day from his work. After 25 days, he has managed to save a certain amount of money. If he initially had $50 in his bank account, how much money does Mark have now?

Nancy is cleaning out her old woodshed. She saw 60 spiders, 1/3rd as many millipedes as spiders, and a number of stink bugs equal to twice the number of millipedes minus 15. How many bugs did she count total?
Alice is some years older than Beth, who is 5 years older than Erica. Erica is 30 years old. If Alice is 12 years older than Erica, how much older is Alice than Beth?

Mel runs a 900-watt air conditioner for 8 hours a day, which means the air conditioner consumes 900 watts of electricity per hour. If he decides to reduce the use of his air conditioner by 5 hours a day, can you calculate how many kilowatts of electricity he will save in 30 days?

While Joanne is gathering apples from her family’s orchard, her sister comes outside to help her. Joanne gathers 30 apples from the tallest trees, half this amount from the shortest trees, and more apples from the average trees. Compared with Joanne, her sister gathers twice as many apples from the tallest trees and 3.2 times as many apples from the shortest trees. She doesn't take any from the average trees. If the sisters have gathered a combined total of 500 apples, how many apples did Joanne gather from the average trees?

Cole wanted to buy new jeans for a dance contest. At the store, he couldn't decide between tattered jeans and jogger jeans. Since the jeans were on sale, he decided to buy them both. The tattered jeans cost $35 while the jogger jeans cost $9 less than the tattered jeans. He saved a total of $9. If he saved 1/3 of the total savings from the jogger jeans and the rest from the tattered jeans, how much more do jogger jeans originally cost than the tattered jeans?

Kenny is selling his Pokemon cards to buy a ticket to an amusement park, which costs $100. He has a collection of cards and plans to sell them for $1.5 each. He keeps 1/3 of them, gives 1/3 of them to his friends, and gets to go to the amusement park with $50 in spending cash. How many cards did he start with?
The vending machines sell chips for 40 cents. George spent $5 and bought 3 bags of chips and had 1% of his money left. If he bought 5 candy bars, how much does a candy bar cost?
The area of Billie's rectangular bedroom is 3.6 square yards. If the length of his room is 3 yards, what is the perimeter of the room in yards?

Jon participates in a triathlon on a day when the temperature is 75 degrees Fahrenheit. He completes the swim in 40 minutes, the bike ride in an hour and 20 minutes, and the run in 50 minutes. On the same day, James also competes in the triathlon. He finishes the swim 10% faster than Jon, even though the water temperature is a chilly 60 degrees Fahrenheit. However, he takes 5 minutes longer on the bike ride, which he attributes to a slight headwind of 5 mph. If Jon still managed to win by 10 minutes, despite the weather conditions, how long did it take James to complete the run?

For her Art class, Beatrice purchased ten sets of crayons. Six of these sets contained eight crayons each, while the remaining four sets contained sixteen crayons each. What is the total number of crayons that Beatrice bought?

A farmer is buying feed for his horses. He buys a variety of hay, oats, carrots, and sugar cubes. Since sugar cubes are a rare treat, he only buys two 1-pound boxes of them for the whole stable. Each box of sugar cubes costs $35. He only wants enough carrots to feed the horses while the vegetables are fresh, so he buys four 12-pound bags. Hay is the main diet of his horses, so he buys forty-two 75-pound bales. Oats are a staple to supplement the hay, so he buys twenty 65-pound sacks. If his farm truck can carry 2250 pounds at a time, how many trips does the farmer need to transport all the feed?

Bob is responsible for doing laundry for a sizable hotel. Each room has three sheets, one comforter, twice as many pillow cases as sheets, and twice as many towels as pillow cases. How many pieces of laundry are there in 100 rooms?

Mary has 60 jars of sprinkles in her pantry. Each jar of sprinkles can decorate 80 cupcakes. Mary wants to bake enough cupcakes to use up all of her sprinkles. If each pan holds 120 cupcakes, how many pans worth of cupcakes should she bake?
Theo bought a pen and a piece of paper that cost $1 less than three times the price of the pen. She gave the cashier $10 and received $3 in return. How much did a pen cost?
Benny saw a 10-foot shark with 2 6-inch remoras and 3 4-inch grass carp attached to it. What percentage of the shark's body length is the combined length of the remoras and grass carp?

It takes 2.4 times of one hundred minutes of walking to break in a new pair of shoes. Jason wants to try out for the track team in three weeks. If he can walk 4 days a week to break in the new shoes, how long does he have to spend walking each day?

Belen has two kinds of pennies, a 2010 penny and a 1959 penny. The 2010 penny is three-quarters of the weight of the 1959 penny. If the 1959 penny weighs 60 grains, what is the combined weight of the two pennies?

Gabriel and Luri each own a portable media player that can store up to 0.1 times of one thousand songs. Gabriel has 1/5 of one hundred songs on his player while Luri has 3 times as many songs. How many fewer songs can Luri add to his player than Gabriel can add to his?

An 8-year old child wants to buy a toy car which costs $12. He already has $4 savings. He also has a collection of 50 marbles, each worth $0. However, he decides not to sell any of his marbles and instead, he promises to save $2 daily from his allowance. How many days will it take him to save the remaining amount of money?

9 out of 10 cheerleaders are 64" tall.  The 10th cheerleader is 60" tall.  They build a human pyramid, where 4 girls are on the bottom,  3 stand on top of the 4, 2 stand on top of the 3, and the shortest girl is at the top. The four girls at the bottom also have a 3-foot-high platform under their feet. How tall is the human pyramid in feet?

Paul is driving a car twice a day: in the morning, and in the afternoon. He did that for 14 days. Each morning ride cost him about $6, and each afternoon ride, about $2. On each trip, he also buys a bottle of water for $1, which he gets reimbursed for at work, and a newspaper for $0.50, which he doesn't pay for because he has a yearly subscription. How much money did he spend on driving his car during these two weeks?

Cherrie decides to purchase Christmas presents for her group of 5 pals. She knows that 2 pals desire 5 presents each, while the remaining 3 pals each wish for 2 presents. After buying these, Cherrie chooses to add an extra surprise by acquiring an additional 10 random presents. What is the total count of presents that Cherrie purchased?

Gerald works at a daycare that pays him $30 every day. He worked for an entire week and spent a total of $100 on groceries. Additionally, he also spent $50 on transportation and $20 on miscellaneous expenses. After all these expenses, how much does he have left?
Julie possessed $500. She used 20% of this amount to buy clothes and then expended 25% of what was left on CDs. What amount of money does Julie still have?
Tara bought 8 packs of 5 canvas bags and 6 packs of 3 hats for $4 each. She painted them and sold them at a craft fair for $8 each. How much profit did she earn on her bags?

Ali has 2/5 of ten $10 bills and six $20 bills that he saved after working for Mr. James on his farm. Ali gives her sister half of the total money he has and uses 0.6 times of the remaining amount of money to buy dinner. Calculate the amount of money he has after buying the dinner.

A shop sells school supplies. One notebook is sold at $1.50 each, a pen at $0.25 each, a calculator at $12 each, and a geometry set at $10. Daniel is an engineering student, and he wants to buy five notebooks, two pens, one calculator, and one geometry set. The shop gives a 10% discount on all the purchased items. However, if Daniel buys more than three notebooks, the shop offers an additional 5% discount on the total price of the notebooks. How much does Daniel have to spend on all the items he wants to buy?

Carly wants to treat her friends. She orders seven hamburgers at $3 each, twelve packs of potato fries at $0.50 each pack, and six cans of fruit drinks at $1.50 each can. How much change does Carly get back if she gives one hundred-dollar bill?

Bill is hosting a party and needs to calculate the number of water bottles he needs to purchase. Initially, he has 2 packs of water, each containing 24 bottles. He is expecting 70 people to attend his party, and he plans to provide 2 bottles of water per person. How many more bottles of water does he need to acquire?
Timothy's locker is 240 cubic inches. Zack's locker is half as big as Timothy's locker. Peter's locker is 1/4 as big as Zack's locker. How big is Peter's locker in cubic inches?

The tooth fairy left Sharon $5.50 in exchange for the first tooth Sharon lost.  Then, the tooth fairy gave Sharon $1.80 for each of the next three teeth Sharon lost.  And for each of the last 2 teeth Sharon lost, the tooth fairy gave Sharon half the amount of money per tooth as Sharon had received for each of the previous three teeth.  How much money did the tooth fairy leave Sharon, in dollars?

Three teenagers are playing soccer on the weekend. Richie, the first teenager, scored 20 more goals than Mark and scored 45 more goals than Anna. If Richie scored 100 goals, how many goals did all three teenagers score?

Leah just got a new kitten. Spaying her cost $200, her 3 vaccines costs $20 each, and the kitten broke 4 vases that cost $12 each. Leah also bought a cat bed for $30 and a scratching post for $25, but she used a gift card to pay for these items. How much has the kitten cost so far, excluding the items paid for with the gift card?

Diane initiated a numerical sequence with a base value of 20. She added half of this number to the base value, divided the sum by 5, and then multiplied the quotient by the difference of the base value and 12. What was the ultimate value of this numerical sequence?

If Martin eats Cheerios every day for breakfast, he'll lose 1.25 pounds/week. If he eats donuts every day for breakfast, he'll gain 1.75 pounds/week. How many weeks will the difference in his weight between the two breakfast options be 15 pounds?

Four dogs sat in a line within the veterinarian's waiting room. The first dog was the Affenpinscher, who weighed only 10 pounds. Next to him sat a Dachshund, who weighed twice as much as the Affenpinscher. Next to the Dachshund sat a Papillon, who weighed 0.25 times as much as the Dachshund. And at the end of the line sat a Mastiff, who weighed 44 times the weight of the Papillon. How much did the Mastiff weigh, in pounds?
Jerry is twice as old as he was 5 years ago. Jerry has a brother who is 3 more years old than Jerry.  How old will Jerry's brother be in 3 years?

Patrick was selling lemonade for six hours. In the first four hours, he managed to sell 15 cups each hour, charging $0.50 for each cup. For the following two hours, he sold 10 cups per hour, but this time he increased the price to $0.60 per cup. Can you calculate the total amount of money, in dollars, that Patrick made from his lemonade sales during this period?

A bus can hold up to 200 passengers. It left Chengli city with 20 passengers on board. At the first stop, an additional 40 passengers got on the bus. At the second stop, the number of passengers that got on was 3/4 of the number that got on at the first stop. If the number of passengers on the bus doubled at the third stop, how many more passengers are needed to reach the bus's maximum capacity?

Pauline visits her favorite local museum three times a year. The cost of one visit is $10. After 10 years, the cost of one visit has increased by 150%, but Pauline decided not to give up any visit and continued to go to the museum for 3 more years. How much did Pauline spend on all visits to the museum?

On Monday, it rained 2 inches. On the same day, a nearby town received 3 inches of rain. However, this does not affect the rainfall in our town. On Tuesday, it is expected to rain 1 more inch than twice of Monday’s total in our town. How many inches of rain will there be in our town on Tuesday?

Susan orders 3 magazines that send 12 issues a year and 3 newspapers.  She has 1 magazine that sends 6 issues a year.  Her last magazine sends her 4 times the amount of the 6 issue magazine.  How many magazines does she get every year?

Charlie is a tennis pro.  He spends most of the day teaching others lessons on how to improve their game.  His standard fee is $100 per hour for lessons, but he reduces his rate by 25% when he is giving lessons to a veteran.   If today Charlie has 4 1-hour lessons at his standard rate and 2 1-hour lessons with a veteran, what is the total amount of money he will make for the day, in dollars?

Walter bought 100 apples from the store. He ate 2/5 of them and gave his sister 25% of the remaining number. If he then sold the remaining apples to his uncle at $3 each, how much money did he receive?
Regina wrote 90 novels last year. If this is 3 quarters of the number of novels she has written this year, how many novels has she written this year?

Bud makes homemade macaroni and cheese once a week.  The pasta costs $1.00 a box, and he spends $3.00 on cheddar cheese and twice that amount for the gruyere cheese. He has a $1 coupon but it had expired.  How much money does Bud spend on making macaroni and cheese in one year?

A custodian has to clean a school with 80 classrooms and a school with 60 classrooms. They have 5 days to get it done. It takes them 15 minutes per classroom. If they work an 8-hour day, what percentage of their day, on average, is spent cleaning classrooms?

Brendan has a bag of marbles with 10 inside. Each marble is worth $3. He tripped over a pebble while carrying it and dropped half of them. He scrambled to search for them but only came up with 3. When he went back home, he inspected the marbles further. One of them he picked up wasn't a marble, but actually a bead so he got rid of it. How many marbles did Brendan end up with?

John spends 5 minutes solving the first face of the Rubik's cube. He takes double this time to solve the next two faces. The final two faces require half the time it took him to solve the first face. Once the fifth face is solved, the sixth face is automatically solved. Can you calculate the total time John spends to solve the Rubik's cube?

Louise, a painter, typically puts a coat of varnish on her work that dries in 7 minutes.  Today, she is experimenting with a kind of new varnish that takes 12 minutes to dry. If she applies this new varnish to her six paintings, how much extra time does it take to dry compared to the varnish she usually uses?

Every day, Crista's plants require watering. She owns 20 plants in total. Four of these plants each require half a cup of water, while eight of them each need a full cup of water. The remaining plants each need a quarter cup of water. Can you calculate the total number of cups of water Crista needs daily to water all her plants?
Bob has $14 to spend on popsicles for his history project. His favorite popsicles come 8 to a box and cost $2.00 per box. How many popsicle sticks can Bob get for his project with his budget?

There are five phones on a phone plan. There are five laptops on another plan. The main phone costs twice as much as each additional phone. If the main phone plan costs $20, how much does the whole phone plan cost, ignoring the other laptop plan?
Mia and Emma are currently 16 years apart in age. They have known each other for 5 years. If Mia, who is younger than Emma, is 40 years old, what's the average of their ages?

An ice cream truck is traveling through a neighborhood. Children from various homes have started chasing the truck and, by the time the truck has reached the end of the first street, there are 10 children it. On the second street, each child is joined by another child and on the third street, each child in the existing group is joined by another 2 children. The original 10 children then give up and leave the group. How many children are now following the truck?

The recent floods in Mamou’s country have left many families without food or shelter. To help, Mamou has volunteered to distribute 12,000 meals to the affected families. She gave out 128 meals on Friday, 360 meals on Saturday, and 448 meals on Sunday. How many meals does she have left to distribute?

Jackie grew 3" over the summer.  She is now 2" shorter than Anne, who is twice the size of Albert.  If Albert is 36" tall, but he was standing on a 2" tall platform when measured, how tall was Jackie before summer?

Jake is purchasing items from a clothing shop. There's a promotion in the shop where if you buy a T-shirt, you get the second one at half price. Jake decides to buy two T-shirts, each originally priced at $8. Additionally, he buys a pair of shoes that are being sold at a discount of 40% from the original price of $40. How much does Jake end up spending in total at the shop?
Justin has a jar with many coins in it. The jar has 48 quarters, 85 dimes, 160 nickels, and 900 pennies. What is the total dollar amount in the jar?

Nate's dog can dig eight holes a day. He digs for 10 days while Nate is on vacation. When Nate gets home, he starts filling in 7 holes a day, but the dog keeps digging 5 new holes every night. How many weeks does it take him to fill in all the holes?

The Adams family is busy making cookies. So far, they've made 7.995 times of one thousand cookies. They have 2595 rainbow cookies, 3.075 times of one thousand oatmeal cookies, and some chocolate chip cookies. How many chocolate chip cookies have they made?

There are some oranges in a basket. Ana spends 3 minutes peeling an orange and Jane spends less minutes doing the same. If Ana and Jane start picking oranges from this basket to peel at the same time, Ana has peeled 5 more oranges than Jane after an hour. What's the speed of Jane in peeling oranges?
